clues.text: Two rivers meet in this city, in the heart of North America. Flat prairie land rolls out all around it, far from any sea.
clues.narrowing: Puts you where two rivers join, on flat prairie in the middle of the continent.

source.quote: This town is at the juncture of the Des Moines and Raccoon Rivers.

clues.text: Summers here are hot and sticky, with storms on many afternoons. Winters turn cold and dry, and lows often fall below zero.
clues.narrowing: Rules out mild shore towns; keeps hot, stormy summers and cold, dry winters.

source.quote: Humidity can be high in spring and summer, with frequent afternoon thunderstorms

clues.text: A fort rose here in 1843, where the two rivers join. In 1857, this town was picked as the state capital, the second one in its history.
clues.narrowing: Cuts the list to a fort town that took the capital job in 1857.

source.quote: In 1857, the name "Fort Des Moines" was shortened to "Des Moines", and it was designated as the second state capital, previously at Iowa City

clues.text: This city is the biggest city in its whole state, and it has held that spot for a long time. It grew up right where its two rivers meet.
clues.narrowing: Nearly a giveaway on size: the state capital is also the state's biggest city.

source.quote: Des Moines has remained Iowa's most populous city.

clues.text: The governor of Iowa works in this city. State lawmakers meet here to make laws for all of Iowa.
clues.narrowing: Confirms it: Iowa's governor and state lawmakers work in this city.

source.quote: Des Moines is the capital and most populous city in the U.S. state of Iowa.

reveal.blurb: A fort rose where two rivers meet in 1843, and the young town took the capital job in 1857. It grew into the biggest city in the state, a hub for farms, banks, and the first big votes for president. Des Moines is the capital of Iowa.
